rationale: Leading independent ME daily; standalone domain whose economy desk carries CBCG payment/card figures first reported verbally.
Second national daily with institutional access to CBCG/MoF; useful cross-check channel for payment statistics claims.
Third national daily; ATM-fraud and cash-handling coverage yields ATM/card facts absent from statistical releases.
Fastest, most structured local mirror of CBCG payment-statistics announcements; highest-yield media feed in this cell.
Public broadcaster economy vertical with durable archive and transcribed regulator interviews on payments and cash.
National agency wire is the upstream for card/payment figures and dedupes downstream noise; URL check failed so re-verify liveness before approval.
English category of the same mina.news wire already captured by the Montenegrin business feed; low marginal signal.
Carried the most granular card/cash transaction breakdown found in the run; standalone domain matching the A4 metric set exactly.
Established portal with economy desk; independent editorial read useful for cross-verifying quoted CBCG figures.
Economy vertical with an open browsable archive, which makes historical back-filling of payment coverage cheap.
Small portal largely redundant with the four larger outlets; keep on the bench unless unique payment items appear.
B2B tender/investment portal surfacing POS/ATM procurement and bank IT contracts; typically registration-gated and URL check failed.
Low-credibility niche consumer-finance portal with failed URL check; weak cash-sentiment signal only, re-check later.
Static media-ownership register; mine once to score outlet independence and discover missing outlets, then archive.
CBCG payment-traffic statistics is the primary upstream series every media figure quotes; failed URL is a soft signal only.
MONSTAT press archive is a recurring upstream for ICT/e-commerce/household indicators touching payment behaviour.
EC enlargement country page produces the annual authoritative assessment of ME payments/financial-services alignment.
Single 2013 screening PDF; valuable historical baseline evidence but not a recurring signal producer.
One-off Council press release on chapter closure; the Council press hub, not this item, would be the monitorable source.
Chapter 4 hub naming the CBCG-led working group and linking government payment-law documents; strong snowball node to mine.
Single planning PDF, but carries dated SEPA/instant-payments commitments no statistical publisher produces.
Government document repository continuously publishing accession and payment-legislation PDFs; durable standalone surface.
EPC is the SEPA scheme authority for ME accession and readiness dates; its news-insights feed is a durable payments source.
